response.overview: It begins when secret agents of M.O.X have previously gone missing without a trace or been killed due to threats from an illegal organization that threatens the safety and stability of the world, calling themselves KFR13. M.O.X is a body headed by 'M', while KFR13 is led by Commander Moshie who carries out illegal activities and is connected to an international terrorist organization based in Alaska and frequently makes various threats to world stability. Operating in complete secrecy equipped with research laboratories and advanced destructive weapons, a spy agent of the M.O.X organization, Don Pedro is assigned to carry out a mission to save the world from the threat of international criminals who want to dominate the world. While executing a secret mission in the Philippines, Don Pedro successfully rescues a Malaysian student named Martias who managed to hack into KFR13's planning information and their weapons formula.
